title: GaitMHAC: A Multi-Head Attention CNN for Pose-Based Gait Recognition Using MediaPipe Pose
content: Every individual has a unique gait, or manner of walking, which has been shown to be a reliable biometric indicator. Current gait recognition methods frequently rely on controlled environments or silhouettes, which restricts their use in natural environments and makes it difficult to identify discriminative spatial-temporal patterns within gait sequences. In this study, we present GaitMHAC, a Multi-head Attention Convolutional Neural Network (MHAC) for gait recognition that uses MediaPipe Pose to extract pose landmark data from videos. The model automatically highlights the most informative features, joints, and temporal sequences using a multi-head attention mechanism to improve generalization ability and robustness. GaitMHAC outperformed baseline deep learning models and traditional classifiers, achieving Top-1 accuracy of 98.29\% and 96.21\%, respectively, evaluated on SMVDU Single Gait (20 subjects) and the recently developed RUET Single Gait (17 subjects). These findings show how multi-head attention-based gait models can be used for biometric applications.
